claim_ceiling: Bounded to the current dependency-directed compose_capabilities plan semantics and the tested MS853-877 capability-candidate admission path. This does not prove learned wholes can never expand behavioral reachability through some later lawful owner; it establishes that the current admitted-whole representation is recursively expanded through its prerequisites and therefore does not itself compress the fixed composition-plan budget.
observed: A recurrent A->B operational motif can still be discovered as proposal-only, independently qualified, and admitted as a current reusable capability whole.
Direct primitive composition of A,B yields plan (A,B); composing the admitted whole yields (A,B,whole), proving the whole is dependency-expanded rather than atomic in the current composer.

A primitive target with dependencies A,B,C fits a four-node plan; a target depending on whole,C expands to A,B,whole,C,target and therefore fails the same four-node plan budget while succeeding at five.
Withholding/staling prerequisite A transitively stales the admitted whole and the second-order dependent target, preserving real dependency/currentness lineage.
